passages.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
passages.sermon: This psalm is for the choirmaster.\r\nThe sons of Korah wrote this psalm.\r\nThey set it to the tune called Gittith.

passages.text: How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!
passages.sermon:
The sons of Korah wrote this psalm.
The choirmaster should use the Gittith for this song.
The LORD of Hosts is the subject.
The LORD of Hosts has a dwelling place.
Your dwelling place is lovely, O LORD of Hosts.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ הַגִּתִּ֑ית לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֥רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃ מַה־ יְּדִיד֥וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶ֗יךָ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Korah wrote this psalm.
They sing to the LORD of Hosts.
My soul longs for the courts of the LORD.
My soul even faints for His courts.
My heart cries out for the living God.
My flesh also cries out for the living God.
passages.original: נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְגַם־ כָּלְתָ֨ה׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְחַצְר֪וֹת יְה֫וָ֥ה לִבִּ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֑י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל־ חָֽי׃

passages.text: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
passages.sermon:
The sparrow finds a home.
The swallow finds a nest for herself.
She places her young in this nest.
She builds her nest near Your altars.
You are the LORD of Hosts.
You are my King.
You are my God.
passages.original: גַּם־ צִפּ֨וֹר׀ מָ֪צְאָה בַ֡יִת וּדְר֤וֹר׀ קֵ֥ן לָהּ֮ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֪תָה אֶפְרֹ֫חֶ֥יהָ אֶֽת־ מִ֭זְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מַ֝לְכִּ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God is King.
God is my God.
People who live in God's house are blessed.
These people praise God all the time.
People who find their strength in God are blessed.
These people have hearts set on pilgrimage.
passages.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃ אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם עֽוֹז־ ל֥וֹ בָ֑ךְ מְ֝סִלּ֗וֹת בִּלְבָבָֽם׃

passages.text: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.
passages.sermon:
People travel through the Valley of Baca.
They turn the valley into a place of springs.
Autumn rain falls on the valley.
The rain fills the valley with pools of water.
passages.original: עֹבְרֵ֤י׀ בְּעֵ֣מֶק הַ֭בָּכָא מַעְיָ֣ן יְשִׁית֑וּהוּ גַּם־ בְּ֝רָכ֗וֹת יַעְטֶ֥ה מוֹרֶֽה׃

passages.text: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
passages.sermon:
The people journey.
They grow stronger at each step.
Each person appears before God.
They meet God in Zion.
passages.original: יֵ֭לְכוּ מֵחַ֣יִל אֶל־ חָ֑יִל יֵרָאֶ֖ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God of Hosts.
He rules over all heavenly armies.
I pray to the LORD God of Hosts.
I ask Him to hear my prayer.
God is also the God of Jacob.
I ask the God of Jacob to listen to me.
Selah.
God is our protector.
I ask God to look at our shield.
God has anointed someone.
I ask God to look with favor on His anointed one.
passages.original: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְ֭בָאוֹת שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י הַאֲזִ֨ינָה אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ מָ֭גִנֵּנוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
passages.sermon:
This psalm is written by the sons of Korah.
They speak to God.
They say one day in God's courts is better than a thousand days elsewhere.
They choose to stand at the doorway of God's house.
They prefer this over living in the tents of wicked people.
passages.original: כִּ֤י טֽוֹב־ י֥וֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶ֗יךָ מֵ֫אָ֥לֶף בָּחַ֗רְתִּי הִ֭סְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֑י מִ֝דּ֗וּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־ רֶֽשַׁע׃

passages.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
passages.sermon:
The LORD God is a sun.
The LORD God is a shield.
The LORD gives grace.
The LORD gives glory.
The LORD does not withhold any good thing.
He gives every good thing to those who walk with integrity.
passages.original: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ׀ וּמָגֵן֮ יְהוָ֪ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע־ ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים׃

passages.text: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
He commands all heavenly armies.
A person who trusts in the LORD is blessed.
Trust in the LORD brings happiness.
God gives blessing to those who rely on Him.
passages.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃
